# David J. Grimsley — Quantum API

> Documentation, SDK, and agent integration resources for the Quantum API —
> a FastAPI service for quantum-inspired runtime features including circuit
> execution, QASM interop, transpilation, local and IBM random jobs,
> and domain algorithms (optimization, experiments, finance, ML, nature).

## Start Here

- [Quantum API Overview](https://davidjgrimsley.com/public-facing/api/quantum):
  Interactive API docs, service overview, and endpoint explorer.

- [API Reference (Markdown)](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/README.md):
  Full REST contract, authentication, configuration, and operations documentation.

- [Agent Contract](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/agent-prompt.md):
  Instructions specifically for coding agents integrating the Quantum API.

- [Agent Skill](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/skills/quantum-api/SKILL.md):
  Installable skill for Antigravity, Cursor, and other supported coding agents.
  Install: `npx skills add davidjgrimsley/quantum-api -g`

- [Machine-Readable Manifest](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/manifest.json):
  API version, SDK versions, endpoint list, and auth modes in JSON.

## REST API

- [Core API Contract](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/skills/quantum-api/references/api-contract.md):
  Core request/response shapes, error envelope, rate-limit headers; use OpenAPI for the exhaustive route catalog.

- [Runtime Credentials](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/skills/quantum-api/references/authentication.md):
  Using a supplied API key and existing IBM profile name.

- [Domain Endpoints (Phase 5)](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/skills/quantum-api/references/domain-endpoints.md):
  Optimization, experiments, finance, ML, and nature algorithm endpoints.

- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/skills/quantum-api/references/troubleshooting.md):
  Common errors, runtime modes, IBM provider issues, rate limits.

## SDKs

- [SDK Integration Guide](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/skills/quantum-api/references/sdks.md):
  Integration instructions for all first-party SDKs.

- [JavaScript / TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/sdk/js/README.md):
  TypeScript client for browser, Node.js, and Expo. Package: `@mr.dj2u/quantum-api`.

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/sdk/python/README.md):
  Sync Python client. Package: `quantum-api-sdk`.

- [PennyLane Plugin](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/sdk/pennylane/README.md):
  PennyLane device `quantum.api`. Package: `quantum-api-pennylane`.

- [Unreal Engine Plugin](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/sdk/unreal/README.md):
  C++ runtime plugin for UE 5.8 Win64.

- [Unity Helper](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/sdk/unity/README.md):
  C# runtime helper package for Unity.

- [Godot Addon](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/addons/quantum_api_client/README.md):
  Reusable GDScript client addon for Godot 4.x, version 0.1.2.

- [SDK Compatibility Matrix](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/docs/sdk/compatibility-matrix.md):
  Per-SDK readiness, supported surface, and auth modes.

- [Beginner Testing Guide](https://github.com/davidjgrimsley/quantum-api/blob/main/docs/operations/phase5-beginner-testing.md):
